Hi team,

We received Invoice 9359 but need confirmation on the EU VAT treatment before our treasury can issue payment. Our AP team is targeting an accelerated payment this week (can do wire or ACH, virtual card is not an option for this vendor). Two quick asks: 

- Please confirm whether Redwood will treat the invoice as net of EU VAT (we need supplier VAT certificate) or if a withholding applies.
- If wire is required, can you provide firm wire instructions and a payment reference text we must use for reconciliation?

We can commit to same-day wire once we have docs + confirmation. If there is any partial-split (EU entity vs. US entity) please outline the split percentages so we can route funds correctly.

Thanks,

Accounts Payable | Skyline Biotech

Daniel — thanks for the quick note and for offering to accelerate. We're happy to get this over the line this week. Short answers below and attached the VAT cert we have on file.

1) VAT treatment: Redwood will invoice net of VAT. For Skyline's EU tax purposes, we confirm that the VAT is not being withheld by your side — you should not apply withholding on this invoice. We've attached our EU VAT certificate to this message (EU_VAT_certificate.pdf).

2) Payment path: We accept wire (preferred) or ACH for US entities. Our wire instructions are attached as a separate doc (Wire_Instructions_SKYLINE_2026.docx). For reconciliation please use the exact payment reference: REDW_INVC_9359_SKY. If you need the beneficiary IBAN instead of account number, the attached doc includes both.

3) Entity split: This invoice is for Redwood Inc. (US). There is no EU-entity split required for Invoice 9359. If Skyline needs to route to a local entity for VAT recovery reasons, we can discuss a future arrangement but it won't change this invoice's payee today.

We can enable same-day wire once you confirm receipt of the cert and instructions. If Skyline can commit to a wire by EOD Monday, we can mark this as expedited and update the ledger.

Best,
Priyom Das
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — billing@redwood.ai
